title: External Agent Runtime Selection
description: The `runtime` block added to Metaproject Subagent Dispatch. Optional and additive: an absent block means the native keryx runtime, so every dispatch authored before this package remains valid. Validation beyond this schema is specified in specification.md section 6.1 and is fail-closed.

kind.description: Which child runtime executes this dispatch. `keryx` runs the in-process agent loop; `external` spawns a vendor CLI subprocess.

agent.description: Registry id of the external agent. Required when kind is `external`; must resolve in the external agent registry.

sandbox.description: Permission level for the external child. Must appear in the registry entry's sandboxModes. `worktree-write` is schema-valid but refused at runtime in the read-only release.

model.description: Model id passed to the external CLI. Omit or null to let the CLI resolve its own default under the operator's active subscription — the runtime never pins a model the account may not be entitled to.

timeoutMs.description: Wall-clock ceiling for this run. Falls back to the configured default when absent.

maxCostUnits.description: Optional cost ceiling forwarded to the CLI's own budget cap where the registry entry reports one, and reserved against the shared RemainingBudgetLedger regardless.
